title.en: Start here: the practice exam, question by question
title.zh: 从这里开始：模拟卷逐题看一遍

description.en: What each of the eighteen questions asks, which lesson teaches it, and how the marks tell you what to write.
description.zh: 十八道题各问什么、在哪一课讲，以及怎样从分值看出该写什么。

title.en: The practice exam, question by question

text.en: The practice exam has 18 questions worth 60 marks, and walks through the layers in the course's order: the physical layer, the data link layer and the MAC sublayer, the network layer, the transport layer, the application layer, and security. Unlike the sample questions of the review lectures, it reaches the lower layers too, and five of its questions need a calculation.
text.zh: 模拟卷一共 18 道题，60 分，按课程的顺序把各层走一遍：物理层、数据链路层和 MAC 子层、网络层、传输层、应用层、网络安全。和复习课的样题不同，它把下面几层也考到了，还有五道题要算。

text.en: Here is each question as a story. Questions 5 and 16 are taught in the unit before this one; every other question has a lesson here, which starts with the question exactly as printed.
text.zh: 先用一句话看看每道题讲的是一件什么事。第 5 题和第 16 题在前一个单元里讲过；其余每道题在这里都有一课，每一课都从题目原文开始。

text.en: Every question shows its marks, and the sample solutions give about one point per mark: four bullets for question 1 (4 marks), two services for question 15 (2 marks). Count the marks before you write, and make each point its own sentence or bullet.
text.zh: 每道题都标了分值，参考答案大致是一分一个要点：第 1 题（4 分）写了四条，第 15 题（2 分）写了两项服务。动笔前先数一数分值，每个要点单独写成一句或一条。

text.en: A third of the marks ask for differences, or advantages and disadvantages: questions 1, 4, 9, 11 and 17, four marks each. Answer them in matched pairs: say the same aspect for both sides (bandwidth for fibre *and* for copper; the purpose of correction *and* of detection), so the examiner sees a contrast rather than two unrelated lists.
text.zh: 三分之一的分数考的是区别或优缺点：第 1、4、9、11、17 题，每题 4 分。答这种题要成对地写：两边说同一个方面（光纤的带宽*和*铜线的带宽；纠错的目的*和*检错的目的），阅卷人看到的是对比，而不是两张不相干的清单。

text.en: Questions 2, 3, 7, 8 and 10 need numbers. Write the rule, put the numbers in, and end with what the result means: *40 kbps*; *forwarded to R2*; */22, because 1024 is the smallest power of 2 that holds 1000*. The working shows the examiner where the number came from.
text.zh: 第 2、3、7、8、10 题要算数。先写规则，再代数，最后说清结果是什么意思：*40 kbps*；*转发给 R2*；*/22，因为 1024 是装得下 1000 的最小的 2 的幂*。过程能让阅卷人看到这个数是怎么来的。

items.en: **The question**, as printed (in English, with the Chinese under it), then a slow read: what each term means and what exactly is asked.
items.zh: **题目**原文（英文，下面附中文），然后慢慢读一遍：每个术语是什么意思，到底在问什么。

items.en: **The ideas** the question needs, from the ground up, with figures.
items.zh: **需要的想法**，从头讲起，配上图。

items.en: **A full-mark answer**: the answer built link by link, then written out as it would earn full marks, with where the marks are.
items.zh: **满分答案**：一环一环把答案搭起来，再按满分标准写出来，并说明分在哪里。

items.en: **The wider topic**: what else the exam can ask here.
items.zh: **这类题的全貌**：这个话题下考试还可能问什么。

items.en: **Your turn**: new questions, some answered in your own words and marked by the tutor against the points an examiner looks for.
items.zh: **你来**：新的题，有些要你用自己的话作答，由助教按阅卷人看重的要点来批改。

body.en: The Chinese version keeps the English terms beside the Chinese, and every full-mark answer is in English, so you can write in the words the examiner expects.
body.zh: 中文版在专业词旁边保留英文，满分答案也用英文写，方便你直接用阅卷人熟悉的词作答。
